text:
Three PDFs, one file, and no account.
Your quote, price list and terms sit in three separate files, and your customer has to guess the order.
On your phone, open iLovePDF and pick Merge PDF.
Tap Select PDF files and choose all three.
They line up in the order you picked them. Drag a file to move it.
Tap Merge PDF. A few seconds later, tap Download merged PDF.
One file, ready to attach. We didn't sign in for any of this.
The catch: the free plan is limited. Its pricing page caps a merge at 25 files and 100 megabytes, and you see ads unless you pay for Premium, which is priced in US dollars.
Send this to the caterer who still emails three attachments with every quote.
